datasets.name: taxi_demand
datasets.displayName: Taxi Demand by Day Hour Zone
queryLines:
SELECT
  TO_DATE(f.pickup_datetime) AS pickup_date,
  DATE_FORMAT(f.pickup_datetime, 'EEEE') AS pickup_day_name,
  f.pickup_taxi_zone_key,
  t.hour_24 AS pickup_hour_24,
  t.hour_label AS pickup_hour_label,
  z.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  z.borough AS pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_volume,
  ROUND(AVG(f.trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(AVG(f.trip_distance), 2) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,
  ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_trip_amount
FROM
  `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
    LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_taxi_zone AS z
      ON f.pickup_taxi_zone_key = z.taxi_zone_key
    LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_time AS t
      ON f.pickup_time_key = t.time_key
WHERE
  f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
GROUP BY
  TO_DATE(f.pickup_datetime),
  DATE_FORMAT(f.pickup_datetime, 'EEEE'),
  f.pickup_taxi_zone_key,
  t.hour_24,
  t.hour_label,
  z.zone_name,
  z.borough
ORDER BY
  trip_volume DESC

datasets.name: kpi_summary
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
    ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_fare_activity,
    ROUND(AVG(f.trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
    ROUND(AVG(f.trip_distance), 2) AS avg_trip_distance_miles
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
),
busiest_zone AS (
  SELECT
    z.zone_name AS busiest_pickup_zone,
    COUNT(*) AS busiest_zone_trips
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_taxi_zone AS z
        ON f.pickup_taxi_zone_key = z.taxi_zone_key
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    z.zone_name
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
peak_hour AS (
  SELECT
    t.hour_24 AS peak_pickup_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS peak_hour_trips
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_time AS t
        ON f.pickup_time_key = t.time_key
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    t.hour_24
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  b.total_trips,
  b.total_fare_activity,
  b.avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  b.avg_trip_distance_miles,
  bz.busiest_pickup_zone,
  bz.busiest_zone_trips,
  ph.peak_pickup_hour,
  ph.peak_hour_trips
FROM
  base b CROSS JOIN busiest_zone bz CROSS JOIN peak_hour ph

datasets.name: weather_behavior
queryLines:
WITH trip_weather AS (
  SELECT
    f.trip_key,
    f.trip_duration_minutes,
    f.trip_distance,
    f.fare_amount,
    f.total_amount,
    w.weather_code,
    w.temperature_2m,
    w.precipitation,
    w.rain,
    w.snowfall,
    w.wind_speed_10m,
    CASE
      WHEN w.weather_code = 0 THEN 'Clear'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 'Cloudy'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (45, 48) THEN 'Fog'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (51, 53, 55, 56, 57) THEN 'Drizzle'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (61, 63, 65, 66, 67, 80, 81, 82) THEN 'Rain'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86) THEN 'Snow'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (95, 96, 99) THEN 'Thunderstorm'
      ELSE 'Other / Unknown'
    END AS weather_condition
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      INNER JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_weather_hour AS w
        ON f.pickup_weather_hour_key = w.weather_hour_key
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
)
SELECT
  weather_condition,
  weather_code,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_volume,
  ROUND(AVG(trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(AVG(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,
  ROUND(AVG(fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_trip_amount,
  ROUND(AVG(temperature_2m), 2) AS trip_weighted_avg_temperature_c,
  ROUND(AVG(precipitation), 2) AS trip_weighted_avg_precipitation_mm,
  ROUND(AVG(rain), 2) AS trip_weighted_avg_rain_mm,
  ROUND(AVG(snowfall), 2) AS trip_weighted_avg_snowfall_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(wind_speed_10m), 2) AS trip_weighted_avg_wind_speed_10m
FROM
  trip_weather
GROUP BY
  weather_condition,
  weather_code
ORDER BY
  trip_volume DESC

datasets.name: area_mobility
queryLines:
WITH pickup_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    COUNT(*) AS pickup_trip_volume,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TO_DATE(f.pickup_datetime)) AS active_pickup_days,
    ROUND(AVG(f.trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
    ROUND(AVG(f.trip_distance), 2) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,
    ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_fare_activity,
    ROUND(AVG(f.total_amount), 2) AS avg_fare_amount,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          w.weather_code BETWEEN 51 AND 67
          OR w.weather_code BETWEEN 71 AND 77
          OR w.weather_code BETWEEN 80 AND 86
          OR w.weather_code BETWEEN 95 AND 99
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS adverse_weather_pickups,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN w.weather_code IN (0, 1, 2, 3) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS clear_or_cloudy_pickups
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_weather_hour AS w
        ON f.pickup_weather_hour_key = w.weather_hour_key
  GROUP BY
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key
),
dropoff_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    dropoff_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    COUNT(*) AS dropoff_trip_volume
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip
  GROUP BY
    dropoff_taxi_zone_key
),
zone_hour_counts AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    pickup_time_key AS pickup_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_volume
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip
  GROUP BY
    pickup_taxi_zone_key,
    pickup_time_key
),
peak_hour AS (
  SELECT
    taxi_zone_key,
    pickup_hour AS peak_pickup_hour,
    trip_volume AS peak_hour_trip_volume
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        taxi_zone_key,
        pickup_hour,
        trip_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY taxi_zone_key
            ORDER BY trip_volume DESC, pickup_hour
          ) AS hour_rank
      FROM
        zone_hour_counts
    )
  WHERE
    hour_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  z.zone_name,
  z.borough,
  z.service_zone,
  p.pickup_trip_volume,
  COALESCE(d.dropoff_trip_volume, 0) AS dropoff_trip_volume,
  p.active_pickup_days,
  p.avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  p.avg_trip_distance_miles,
  p.total_fare_activity,
  p.avg_fare_amount,
  ph.peak_pickup_hour,
  ph.peak_hour_trip_volume,
  p.adverse_weather_pickups,
  p.clear_or_cloudy_pickups,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * p.adverse_weather_pickups
      / NULLIF(p.adverse_weather_pickups + p.clear_or_cloudy_pickups, 0),
    2
  ) AS adverse_weather_pickup_share_pct
FROM
  pickup_metrics AS p
    LEFT JOIN dropoff_metrics AS d
      ON p.taxi_zone_key = d.taxi_zone_key
    LEFT JOIN peak_hour AS ph
      ON p.taxi_zone_key = ph.taxi_zone_key
    LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_taxi_zone AS z
      ON p.taxi_zone_key = z.taxi_zone_key
ORDER BY
  p.pickup_trip_volume DESC,
  p.total_fare_activity DESC

datasets.name: top_pickup_zones
queryLines:
-- SECTION 2: Busiest Pickup Zones with Revenue Context
SELECT
  z.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  z.borough AS pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_volume,
  ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_fare_revenue
FROM
  fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
    INNER JOIN dim_taxi_zone AS z
      ON f.pickup_taxi_zone_key = z.taxi_zone_key
GROUP BY
  z.zone_name,
  z.borough
ORDER BY
  trip_volume DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: kpi_overview
queryLines:
-- SECTION 1: Executive Overview KPIs
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_fare_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(AVG(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN dq_missing_weather_coverage = TRUE THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS trips_missing_weather,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN dq_missing_weather_coverage = TRUE THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS pct_trips_missing_weather
FROM
  fact_green_taxi_trip
WHERE
  dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE

datasets.name: demand_by_day_hour
datasets.displayName: Trip Demand by Day and Hour
queryLines:
-- SECTION 2: When Demand is Highest - Day/Hour Heatmap
SELECT
  dd.day_name AS pickup_day_name,
  dt.hour_label AS pickup_hour_label,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_volume
FROM
  fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
    INNER JOIN dim_date AS dd
      ON f.pickup_date_key = dd.date_key
    INNER JOIN dim_time AS dt
      ON f.pickup_time_key = dt.time_key
WHERE
  dt.time_key > 0 -- Exclude Unknown time
GROUP BY
  dd.day_name,
  dt.hour_label
ORDER BY
  CASE dd.day_name
    WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5
    WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6
    WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7
  END,
  dt.hour_label

datasets.name: weather_impact
queryLines:
-- SECTION 3: Weather Effects on Demand and Behavior
-- Classify weather_code into readable conditions
-- Include Unknown/missing weather in counts but exclude from averages
WITH classified_trips AS (
  SELECT
    f.trip_key,
    f.trip_duration_minutes,
    f.trip_distance,
    f.fare_amount,
    f.total_amount,
    w.weather_code,
    w.temperature_2m,
    CASE
      WHEN f.pickup_weather_hour_key = 0 THEN 'Unknown / No Coverage'
      WHEN w.weather_code = 0 THEN 'Clear'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 'Cloudy'
      WHEN w.weather_code IN (45, 48) THEN 'Fog'
      WHEN w.weather_code BETWEEN 51 AND 57 THEN 'Drizzle'
      WHEN
        w.weather_code BETWEEN 61 AND 67
        OR w.weather_code BETWEEN 80 AND 82
      THEN
        'Rain'
      WHEN
        w.weather_code BETWEEN 71 AND 77
        OR w.weather_code BETWEEN 85 AND 86
      THEN
        'Snow'
      WHEN w.weather_code BETWEEN 95 AND 99 THEN 'Thunderstorm'
      ELSE 'Other / Unknown'
    END AS weather_condition
  FROM
    fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      LEFT JOIN dim_weather_hour AS w
        ON f.pickup_weather_hour_key = w.weather_hour_key
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
)
SELECT
  weather_condition,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_volume,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN weather_condition != 'Unknown / No Coverage' THEN trip_duration_minutes
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN weather_condition != 'Unknown / No Coverage' THEN trip_distance
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN weather_condition != 'Unknown / No Coverage' THEN fare_amount
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS avg_fare_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_trip_amount,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN weather_condition != 'Unknown / No Coverage' THEN temperature_2m
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS avg_temperature_c
FROM
  classified_trips
GROUP BY
  weather_condition
ORDER BY
  CASE weather_condition
    WHEN 'Clear' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Cloudy' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Fog' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Drizzle' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Rain' THEN 5
    WHEN 'Snow' THEN 6
    WHEN 'Thunderstorm' THEN 7
    WHEN 'Other / Unknown' THEN 8
    WHEN 'Unknown / No Coverage' THEN 9
  END

datasets.name: zone_mobility
queryLines:
WITH pickup_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    COUNT(*) AS pickup_trip_volume,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TO_DATE(f.pickup_datetime)) AS active_pickup_days,
    ROUND(AVG(f.trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
    ROUND(AVG(f.trip_distance), 2) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,
    ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_trip_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(f.total_amount), 2) AS avg_trip_amount,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          w.weather_code IN (
            51, 53, 55, 56, 57, 61, 63, 65, 66, 67, 71, 73, 75, 77, 80, 81, 82, 85, 86, 95, 96, 99
          )
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS adverse_weather_pickups,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN w.weather_code IN (0, 1, 2, 3) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS clear_or_cloudy_pickups
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_weather_hour AS w
        ON f.pickup_weather_hour_key = w.weather_hour_key
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key
),
dropoff_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    dropoff_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    COUNT(*) AS dropoff_trip_volume
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip
  WHERE
    dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    dropoff_taxi_zone_key
),
zone_hour_counts AS (
  SELECT
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    t.hour_24 AS pickup_hour_24,
    t.hour_label AS pickup_hour_label,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_volume
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_time AS t
        ON f.pickup_time_key = t.time_key
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key,
    t.hour_24,
    t.hour_label
),
peak_hour AS (
  SELECT
    taxi_zone_key,
    pickup_hour_24 AS peak_pickup_hour_24,
    pickup_hour_label AS peak_pickup_hour_label,
    trip_volume AS peak_hour_trip_volume
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY taxi_zone_key
            ORDER BY trip_volume DESC, pickup_hour_24 ASC NULLS LAST
          ) AS hour_rank
      FROM
        zone_hour_counts
    )
  WHERE
    hour_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(p.taxi_zone_key, d.taxi_zone_key) AS taxi_zone_key,
  z.zone_name,
  z.borough,
  z.service_zone,
  COALESCE(p.pickup_trip_volume, 0) AS pickup_trip_volume,
  COALESCE(d.dropoff_trip_volume, 0) AS dropoff_trip_volume,
  COALESCE(p.active_pickup_days, 0) AS active_pickup_days,
  p.avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  p.avg_trip_distance_miles,
  p.total_trip_amount,
  p.avg_trip_amount,
  ph.peak_pickup_hour_24,
  ph.peak_pickup_hour_label,
  ph.peak_hour_trip_volume,
  p.adverse_weather_pickups,
  p.clear_or_cloudy_pickups,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * p.adverse_weather_pickups
      / NULLIF(p.adverse_weather_pickups + p.clear_or_cloudy_pickups, 0),
    2
  ) AS adverse_weather_pickup_share_pct
FROM
  pickup_metrics AS p
    FULL OUTER JOIN dropoff_metrics AS d
      ON p.taxi_zone_key <=> d.taxi_zone_key
    LEFT JOIN peak_hour AS ph
      ON p.taxi_zone_key <=> ph.taxi_zone_key
    LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_taxi_zone AS z
      ON COALESCE(p.taxi_zone_key, d.taxi_zone_key) = z.taxi_zone_key
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(p.pickup_trip_volume, 0) DESC,
  COALESCE(p.total_trip_amount, 0) DESC

datasets.name: demand_by_date
queryLines:
-- SECTION 2: Trip Volume by Pickup Date Trend
SELECT
  dd.full_date AS pickup_date,
  dd.day_name AS pickup_day_name,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_volume,
  ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_fare_revenue
FROM
  fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
    INNER JOIN dim_date AS dd
      ON f.pickup_date_key = dd.date_key
GROUP BY
  dd.full_date,
  dd.day_name
ORDER BY
  dd.full_date

datasets.name: fare_per_mile_borough
queryLines:
SELECT
    z.borough,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_volume,
    ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_trip_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(f.trip_distance), 2) AS total_distance_miles,
    ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(f.trip_distance), 0), 2) AS avg_fare_per_mile

FROM `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f

LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_taxi_zone AS z
    ON f.pickup_taxi_zone_key = z.taxi_zone_key

WHERE f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE

GROUP BY z.borough

ORDER BY trip_volume DESC;

datasets.name: data_quality
queryLines:
-- SECTION 5: Data Quality Flags Summary
SELECT
  z.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  z.borough AS pickup_borough,
  dt.hour_label AS pickup_hour_label,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = TRUE THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS trips_out_of_range_datetime,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN f.dq_invalid_trip_duration = TRUE THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS trips_invalid_duration,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN f.dq_zero_trip_distance = TRUE THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS trips_zero_distance,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN f.dq_extreme_trip_distance = TRUE THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS trips_extreme_distance,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips
FROM
  fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
    INNER JOIN dim_taxi_zone AS z
      ON f.pickup_taxi_zone_key = z.taxi_zone_key
    INNER JOIN dim_time AS dt
      ON f.pickup_time_key = dt.time_key
WHERE
  f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = TRUE
  OR f.dq_invalid_trip_duration = TRUE
  OR f.dq_zero_trip_distance = TRUE
  OR f.dq_extreme_trip_distance = TRUE
GROUP BY
  z.zone_name,
  z.borough,
  dt.hour_label
ORDER BY
  total_trips DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: weekend_weekday
queryLines:
-- SECTION 5: Weekend vs Weekday Comparison
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN dd.is_weekend = TRUE THEN 'Weekend'
    ELSE 'Weekday'
  END AS day_type,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_volume,
  ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) AS total_fare_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(f.trip_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(AVG(f.trip_distance), 2) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,
  ROUND(AVG(f.total_amount), 2) AS avg_fare_per_trip
FROM
  fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
    INNER JOIN dim_date AS dd
      ON f.pickup_date_key = dd.date_key
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN dd.is_weekend = TRUE THEN 'Weekend'
    ELSE 'Weekday'
  END
ORDER BY
  day_type

datasets.name: monthly_volume
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', dd.full_date) as trip_month,
  COUNT(*) as trip_volume,
  ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount), 2) as total_fare_revenue
FROM
  `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
    INNER JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_date AS dd
      ON f.pickup_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE
  dd.full_date >= '2026-03-01'
  AND dd.full_date < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', dd.full_date)
ORDER BY
  trip_month

datasets.name: zone_hour_volume
datasets.displayName: Zone x Hour Pickup Volume Matrix
queryLines:
WITH zone_totals AS (
    SELECT
        pickup_zone,
        SUM(trip_volume) AS total_zone_volume
    FROM `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.analytics_taxi_demand
    GROUP BY pickup_zone
    ORDER BY total_zone_volume DESC
    LIMIT 20
)

SELECT
    a.pickup_zone,
    a.pickup_hour_24,
    a.pickup_hour_label,
    SUM(a.trip_volume) AS trip_volume

FROM `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.analytics_taxi_demand AS a

INNER JOIN zone_totals AS z
    ON a.pickup_zone = z.pickup_zone

GROUP BY
    a.pickup_zone,
    a.pickup_hour_24,
    a.pickup_hour_label

ORDER BY a.pickup_zone, a.pickup_hour_24;

datasets.name: top_zones_activity
datasets.displayName: Top 15 Zones Pickup and Dropoff Activity
queryLines:
WITH pickup_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    COUNT(*) AS pickup_trip_volume
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key
),
dropoff_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    dropoff_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    COUNT(*) AS dropoff_trip_volume
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip
  WHERE
    dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    dropoff_taxi_zone_key
)
SELECT
  z.zone_name,
  COALESCE(p.pickup_trip_volume, 0) AS pickup_trip_volume,
  COALESCE(d.dropoff_trip_volume, 0) AS dropoff_trip_volume
FROM
  pickup_metrics AS p
    FULL OUTER JOIN dropoff_metrics AS d
      ON p.taxi_zone_key <=> d.taxi_zone_key
    LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_taxi_zone AS z
      ON COALESCE(p.taxi_zone_key, d.taxi_zone_key) = z.taxi_zone_key
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(p.pickup_trip_volume, 0) DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH pickup_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
    COUNT(*) AS pickup_trip_volume,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          w.weather_code IN (
            51, 53, 55, 56, 57, 61, 63, 65, 66, 67, 71, 73, 75, 77, 80, 81, 82, 85, 86, 95, 96, 99
          )
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS adverse_weather_pickups,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN w.weather_code IN (0, 1, 2, 3) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS clear_or_cloudy_pickups
  FROM
    `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f
      LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_weather_hour AS w
        ON f.pickup_weather_hour_key = w.weather_hour_key
  WHERE
    f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    f.pickup_taxi_zone_key
)
SELECT
  z.zone_name,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * p.adverse_weather_pickups
      / NULLIF(p.adverse_weather_pickups + p.clear_or_cloudy_pickups, 0),
    2
  ) AS adverse_weather_pickup_share_pct
FROM
  pickup_metrics AS p
    LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_taxi_zone AS z
      ON p.taxi_zone_key = z.taxi_zone_key
WHERE
  p.adverse_weather_pickups + p.clear_or_cloudy_pickups > 0
ORDER BY
  adverse_weather_pickup_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH pickup_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        f.pickup_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,

        COUNT(*) AS pickup_trip_volume,
        COUNT(DISTINCT TO_DATE(f.pickup_datetime)) AS active_pickup_days,

        AVG(f.trip_duration_minutes) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes,
        AVG(f.trip_distance) AS avg_trip_distance_miles,

        SUM(f.total_amount) AS total_trip_amount,
        AVG(f.total_amount) AS avg_trip_amount,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN w.weather_code IN (
                    51, 53, 55, 56, 57,
                    61, 63, 65, 66, 67,
                    71, 73, 75, 77,
                    80, 81, 82,
                    85, 86,
                    95, 96, 99
                )
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS adverse_weather_pickups,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN w.weather_code IN (0, 1, 2, 3)
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS clear_or_cloudy_pickups

    FROM `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f

    LEFT JOIN `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.dim_weather_hour AS w
        ON f.pickup_weather_hour_key = w.weather_hour_key

    WHERE f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE

    GROUP BY f.pickup_taxi_zone_key
),

dropoff_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        f.dropoff_taxi_zone_key AS taxi_zone_key,
        COUNT(*) AS dropoff_trip_volume

    FROM `ftw-week-08`.`03_gold`.fact_green_taxi_trip AS f

    WHERE f.dq_out_of_range_datetime = FALSE

    GROUP BY f.dropoff_taxi_zone_key
),

zone_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.taxi_zone_key,

        p.pickup_trip_volume,
        COALESCE(d.dropoff_trip_volume, 0) AS dropoff_trip_volume,

        p.active_pickup_days,
        p.avg_trip_duration_minutes,
        p.avg_trip_distance_miles,
        p.total_trip_amount,
        p.avg_trip_amount,

        100.0 * p.adverse_weather_pickups /
        NULLIF(
            p.adverse_weather_pickups + p.clear_or_cloudy_pickups,
            0
        ) AS adverse_weather_pickup_share_pct

    FROM pickup_metrics AS p

    LEFT JOIN dropoff_metrics AS d
        ON p.taxi_zone_key <=> d.taxi_zone_key
),

correlations AS (

    SELECT
        'Pickup volume vs Drop-off volume' AS relationship,
        CORR(pickup_trip_volume, dropoff_trip_volume) AS pearson
    FROM zone_metrics

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Pickup volume vs Average duration',
        CORR(pickup_trip_volume, avg_trip_duration_minutes)
    FROM zone_metrics

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Pickup volume vs Average distance',
        CORR(pickup_trip_volume, avg_trip_distance_miles)
    FROM zone_metrics

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Pickup volume vs Average trip amount',
        CORR(pickup_trip_volume, avg_trip_amount)
    FROM zone_metrics

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Pickup volume vs Adverse-weather share',
        CORR(pickup_trip_volume, adverse_weather_pickup_share_pct)
    FROM zone_metrics

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Drop-off volume vs Average trip amount',
        CORR(dropoff_trip_volume, avg_trip_amount)
    FROM zone_metrics

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Average distance vs Average duration',
        CORR(avg_trip_distance_miles, avg_trip_duration_minutes)
    FROM zone_metrics

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Average duration vs Average trip amount',
        CORR(avg_trip_duration_minutes, avg_trip_amount)
    FROM zone_metrics
)

SELECT
    relationship,
    ROUND(pearson, 3) AS pearson
FROM correlations
ORDER BY ABS(pearson) DESC;
